name: ownership
label: Ownership
help: Default current. "any" can return many more rows.

name: limit
label: Limit
help: The maximum number of properties to return in total (1 to 5000, default 25). They are requested in pages of up to 100, and never more than this number are requested.

name: pageCursor
label: Start from page cursor
help: Optional. Leave empty to start at the first page. The Limit already pages for you, so use this only to continue an earlier run from its Next Page Cursor.
